recommendation.headline: Offer a partial refund of $24.00 (the proportional value of one damaged mug) with return not required, or request a return for a full refund under shop policy.
recommendation.rationale: The buyer received a set of 4 mugs for $96.00 ($24 per mug), where one mug arrived chipped. While our shop policy requires returns for items not as described or damaged to get a full refund, offering a partial refund of $24.00 for the single damaged mug resolves the dispute efficiently and fairly without forcing the buyer to ship back the remaining three undamaged mugs. Alternatively, we can offer a full refund upon return of the full set. Fighting this dispute in full would likely fail because the customer provided proof of a chipped rim.

evidence.summary: Customer reached out stating one mug has a chip on the rim and the blue is darker than expected.
Shop policy states returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery. Buyer pays return shipping unless item arrived damaged or not as described.
USPS tracking shows the package was delivered on October 1, 2026 at 77 Union Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11211.

recommendation.response_to_paypal: Hello, we are sorry to hear that one of the four mugs arrived with a chip. Since the set was purchased for $96.00 ($24.00 per mug), we are issuing a partial refund of $24.00 for the damaged mug, or we are happy to accept a return of the full set for a complete refund per our shop policy.
risks: The buyer might reject the partial refund and demand a full refund or escalate to a claim.
PayPal might encourage a full return instead of a partial refund if escalated.
